I need you to provide specific instructions about what to standardize. I cannot proceed without knowing what changes you want me to make.

Please give me clear, specific directions such as:

- "Standardize all dates to YYYY format"
- "Convert all titles to title case"
- "Fix spacing issues in column X"
- "Standardize object numbers to format Y"
- Or any other specific standardization rule

**What exactly should I change in this file?**
